description: One config type's fields as Forge edits and validates them: key, value type, default, whether it is required, description and allowed values. Long option lists are shortened; pass field to get one field with all its options.

field.description: Optional field key; returns only that field, with every allowed value.

type.description: A type from list_config_types, such as "custom-boss" or "fmm-pet".

name: get_config_schema
